name: TelegramBridgeAgent
description: Bidirectional bridge between Telegram and CortexAgent. Forwards Telegram messages to CortexAgent via CommandBridge and sends responses back to the user.
inputs: Telegram messages from configured chat IDs
outputs: Telegram messages sent back to user

envVars.name: KOUPPER_TELEGRAM_TOKEN
envVars.description: Telegram Bot API token from BotFather

envVars.name: KOUPPER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_IDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed chat IDs. Empty = accept all.

setup: Add chat ID to allowedChatIds in telegram.json
